subject: general
question: Simplify the following: (1+cot ² theta)/(1+tan² theta)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using **Trigonometric Identities**: 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ and 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ.

Expression = cosec²θ ÷ sec²θ = (1/sin²θ) ÷ (1/cos²θ) = cos²θ / sin²θ = cot²θ.

Since cot²θ = cosec²θ − 1, the result matches **cosec²θ − 1**.

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²θ − 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (1 + cot²θ) ÷ (1 + tan²θ)

**Formula Used:** 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ; cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

⇒ (1 + cot²θ) / (1 + tan²θ)

⇒ cosec²θ / sec²θ

⇒ (1 / sin²θ) / (1 / cos²θ)

⇒ cos²θ / sin²θ

⇒ cot²θ

⇒ cosec²θ − 1

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²θ − 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

Standard relations: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ.

Ratio Identities

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ and cot θ = cos θ / sin θ.</p
